triage_risk_rating.rationale: Initiation is somewhat likely because a high-severity NetWitness alert with risk score 70 flags abnormal broadcast/multicast traffic from 192.168.10.14, occurrence is somewhat likely given repeated high-risk telemetry indicators but no confirmed exploit payload or process evidence, and adverse impact is low because the incident is limited to network anomaly data with no evidence of endpoint compromise, data loss, or configuration change.

incident_details.title: High Risk Alerts: ESA for 192.168.10.14
incident_details.description: This alert shows network activity from 192.168.10.14 to broadcast/multicast destinations, which is anomalous but only supported by network telemetry. There is no evidence of PowerShell execution, endpoint compromise, or malicious payload behavior, so this is best treated as suspicious activity requiring investigation rather than a confirmed intrusion.
